metadata.description: 45 skills, 20 agents, and 3 team workflows for software engineering: knowledge, tools, playbooks, frameworks, AI engineering, and agents, plus the loop-virtuoso Claude Code plugin

plugins.name: knowledge-virtuoso
plugins.description: 6 knowledge skills: accessibility, context engineering, debugging, docs lookup, performance, and security

plugins.name: tools-virtuoso
plugins.description: 13 tool skills: rules writer, ticket writer, agent creator, skill writer, skill measure, plugin creator, research, brainstorming, communication style, PR message writer, report writer, stakeholder update writer, and UI review

plugins.name: playbooks-virtuoso
plugins.description: 8 playbook skills: spec-driven development, TDD, branch finishing, PR feedback, handoff, hooks and guardrails, game feature loop, and security research

plugins.name: frameworks-virtuoso
plugins.description: 6 framework skills: Symfony upgrade, PHP upgrade, Composer dependencies, Godot and Godot upgrade, and Vercel AI SDK

plugins.name: ai-virtuoso
plugins.description: 2 AI engineering skills: LLM evals and LLM observability

plugins.name: agents-virtuoso
plugins.description: 20 agents (specialists and roles), 3 team workflows, and the verification skill, plus headless wrapper skills for CI review, test gaps, migration planning, dependency audit, and refactor scans

plugins.name: loop-virtuoso
plugins.description: Claude Code only. A backlog-driven delivery loop that feeds the agent one small item at a time and accepts it only when verify commands pass and a write-boundary guard approves. Also opt-in guard hooks, a settings hardener, a setup audit (doctor), setup evals against vanilla Claude Code, and starter templates. Ships hooks, scripts, commands, and 2 skills
